en: HEADLINE: THERE IS NO 20 SEP SCAN - Sunday was not run - so every comparison in this report is against 19 Sep, two days back, and all three source windows advanced two days with it.

THE WEAKEST GSC READING IN THIS SERIES: clicks 43 -> 36, impressions 1,188 -> 1,146, CTR 3.6% -> 3.1% and average position 30.8 -> 31.3. The query table nonetheless grew 90 -> 97 rows, all of them low-impression tail.

TWO MELBOURNE QUERIES COLLAPSED: '3d rendering melbourne' 46.0 -> 75.2 (impressions 31 -> 17) and 'architectural rendering melbourne' 29.1 -> 56.0 (16 -> 6). These are the worst two-day moves this report has recorded.

BUT INDEXING POSTED ITS BEST MOVE YET: the Page indexing build finally rebuilt (14 Sep -> 18 Sep), indexed pages 76 -> 83 and not indexed 146 -> 142. 'Crawled - currently not indexed' fell 57 -> 48, which is exactly where the seven newly indexed pages came from.
GOOGLE RE-READ THE SITEMAP TODAY (21 Sep, previously stuck on 13 Sep) and Discovered pages jumped 109 -> 116, matching the live sitemap exactly for the first time in this series.

SPEED IS BACK UNDER ONE SECOND EVERYWHERE: all 115 pages under 1s. Site mean 346 -> 330 ms and median 279 -> 271 ms; the 2,006 ms cold read of the /articles hub on 19 Sep did not repeat (528 ms in the crawl, 256-573 ms on re-reads).

THE BACKLINK SPAM IS STILL ARRIVING, more slowly: referring domains 573 -> 621 and backlinks 607 -> 656 over two days, with the followed share essentially unchanged (42.9% -> 43.6%). The disavow review raised as P0 on 19 Sep is still outstanding.
GA4: sessions 593 -> 615 and users 389 -> 413, but engagement 39.29% -> 38.21% and average engagement time 36s -> 34s. More visits, less attention.
ENGAGEMENT FELL FOR A FOURTH STRAIGHT WEEK: the last 7 days (14-20 Sep) took 172 sessions at 26.74% and 6 seconds, against 109 sessions at 42.2% and 22 seconds the week before.
ZERO KEY EVENTS across both 7-day windows for a FIFTEENTH consecutive scan. The 28-day count held at 5, all of them attributed to Organic Search.

ONE NEW ARTICLE: /articles/kitchen-renovation-cost-melbourne (4,782 words, FAQPage from day one, 25 internal links) takes the library to 92 and the sitemap to 116 URLs. It also went out on Facebook the same day and opened at 22 views.

AI: Ahrefs responses 19 -> 17 and distinct cited pages 10 -> 9, the whole fall on Copilot (8 -> 6). Google AI Overviews and AI Mode remain at zero. The AI Visibility score holds at 30/100 for a fourteenth scan.
ONE METRIC COULD NOT BE READ: GA4's Session source / medium dimension switcher would not open this run, so that field is null rather than carried forward from 19 Sep.
Orphan articles hold at 0 for a tenth crawl; the hub links all 92 articles; 26 articles are reachable only from the hub (25 -> 26).
The /articles overlay is on its 25th DAY - still blocking human readers even though it does not block crawlers.
Every commercial non-brand query is still at ZERO clicks across the full 28 days, for the fifteenth scan. Brand terms take 30 of 36 clicks (83.3%).
Ahrefs Site Audit ran fresh at 04:04 this morning: health 100% but only 14 URLs crawled - it does not describe a 115-page site.
Brand Radar still tracks 0 prompts and shows AI SoV as a dash, for a twenty-sixth scan.
Social: FB views 4,358 -> 4,564, IG views 2,223 -> 2,497, YT views 525 -> 662 as the 18 Sep Short entered the window; LinkedIn kept falling (impressions 1,404 -> 1,350). Total followers flat at 271.
